events.title: Building teams and student groups
events.note: Both schools form their project teams and select their students. At LTEtt the project is presented in all 5e classes from 9 to 13 November; students apply until Tuesday 17 November 2026. Set up a quick contact channel (WhatsApp).

events.title: Project work in class
events.note: Students start working on the project in the first or second week of November.

events.title: Terceira → Ettelbruck
events.note: Saturday 27 February to Saturday 6 March 2027. About 8 students and 2 teachers from the Azores stay with host families in Luxembourg. Includes a day at the European Parliament in Brussels.

events.title: Ettelbruck → Terceira
events.note: End of April 2027. Proposed: Thursday 22 to Friday 30 April (flights via Lisbon). About 8 students and up to 3 teachers; host families on Terceira. Dates still to be confirmed by both schools.
